name: V-Mart Retail Ltd
title: V-Mart Retail Ltd - 534976 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue +24% with 12% LTL (10th straight quarter) and EBITDA +56% to INR106 cr at 10.9% margin, but gross margin fell 1% and capex is guided up to INR170-180 cr.

capex.quote: For the next year, the capex is estimated at roughly around INR170 crores, INR180 crores.

triggers.label: Days of inventory down 3 days
triggers.quote: our days of inventory also improved by 3 days, which is on a 5-quarter rolling average basis

triggers.label: Yarn up 10-15%, apparel cost up 5-7%
triggers.quote: there is a rise of almost 10% to 15% in the yarn prices, which effectively converts to almost 5% to 7% in the apparel prices

triggers.label: Capex guided up to INR170-180 cr
triggers.quote: For the next year, the capex is estimated at roughly around INR170 crores, INR180 crores.

triggers.label: Competitors opening many stores
triggers.quote: The competition has got good targets, where they're trying to open up a lot of stores in the coming quarters and coming year as well.

triggers.label: Store additions guided 13-15% area growth
triggers.quote: The guidance for the next year remains the same at 13% to 15% area addition every year

guidance.value: 13% to 15% every year, net of 1-2% closures
guidance.quote: The guidance for the next year remains the same at 13% to 15% area addition every year
For the next year, the capex is estimated at roughly around INR170 crores, INR180 crores.
So right now we are around 14.5% we want to go to 18% and then maybe 20% and above 20%.
we should be hovering and then we should be comfortable around say 6%, 7% to 7.5% and 7% is the ballpark figure

red_flags.label: Gross margin down 1% YoY with inventory provisions
red_flags.quote: gross margins actually for the quarter decreased year-on-year by 1%. This was on account of provision taken on inventory

red_flags.label: Crude-linked input cost squeeze on FY27 deliveries
red_flags.quote: all the raw materials, all the products, all the services, which are all getting affected because of the crude oil prices going up

red_flags.label: Management declined to give margin timeline
red_flags.quote: Now to set a timeline, whether this will happen in the next year or the year after that, I can't see that.

evasions.quote: Now to set a timeline, whether this will happen in the next year or the year after that, I can't see that.
